notes: Contact: Priya Anand (Head of Search) — very hands-on, cares about tail latency
Primary product: enterprise contract search & clause discovery (customers include law firms and corporate legal teams)
Scale: currently ~30M raw docs (PDFs + extracted text). After chunking expect ~180M to 250M vectors depending on chunk strategy.
Quote from call: 'We need predictable 95th percentile latency under load; if reranker slows everything to a crawl it's a no-go.'
They are evaluating vendor fit around vector store connectors — want turnkey connectors for Pinecone, Weaviate and pgvector (self-hosted Postgres).
Cost sensitivity: medium-high; cost per query target ~ $0.003-$0.01 total (embeddings + retrieval + rerank) depending on QPS and SLA.
Preferred embedding model: open-source SBERT-like vectors or small OpenAI-style model they can self-host; willing to try Redwood-hosted embeddings for PoC.
Reranker preference: cross-encoder reranker (all-mpnet/all-MiniLM or distilled cross-encoder) to push precision on top-10 candidates.
They need hybrid search: BM25 for recall + vector similarity for semantic, with metadata filters (jurisdiction, client-id, doc-type).
Multi-tenant namespace per client required; per-namespace residency for EU customers.
Integration notes: ingestion pipeline uses S3 + Glue; they'd like CDC support (Kafka) for near-real-time upserts; connector must support bulk upsert + streaming updates.
Operational asks: snapshot/backup export, index size estimates, storage cost breakdown, and per-query cost model for different QPS profiles.
Risk flags: procurement will push for right-to-audit, stricter data retention, on-prem option for a few clients (air-gapped eval later).
Internal: Maya to prototype sample connector to pgvector and run 10k query throughput benchmark with fallback reranker disabled/enabled.
workload_requirements: Index scale target: 150M-250M vectors initial; growth 20% qtrly
Query profile: mixed traffic — baseline 200 QPS, peak sustained bursts to 800 QPS (expected to be rate-limited for POC)
Latency SLOs: cold p95 retrieval+rerank <= 350ms for low-complexity queries; target production p95 <= 200ms (aggressive for reranker)
Throughput: need ability to handle 1k QPS for embedding-only queries (search-less telemetry) with autoscale
Cost per query target: $0.003 - $0.01 (end-to-end) — strong sensitivity to per-token reranker costs
Reranking window: top-100 candidates retrieved, rerank top-10 with cross-encoder; prefer ability to vary candidate set size dynamically
Embedding dim and model: 384-1024 dims depending on model; want connector to accept different dims without reindexing entire dataset
connector_requirements: Must support Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector (self-hosted Postgres) and Elastic vector plugin as possible backends
Incremental upserts with idempotency and field-level metadata updates
Support for hybrid queries (vector + BM25) and filtering by arbitrary metadata fields
CDC ingestion option: Kafka connector or webhook listener for near-real-time delta updates
Namespace / tenant isolation: per-namespace quotas, per-namespace residency and KMS key scoping
Bulk import tooling: S3 -> index bulk loader with manifest and resumable uploads
Online reindex / rollforward: zero-downtime index swap / aliasing for new vector versions
Explainability hooks: surface top-k candidate distances + metadata to feed reranker metrics and audits
SDK requirements: Python + Java client with async upsert and query streaming, examples for Airflow/Glue
Monitoring/telemetry: per-query latency breakdown (retrieval vs rerank vs encode), token usage, and cost estimate signals
